name: Subscribe
layerWhy: It does one whole job, subscribing someone, end to end with its feedback, from primitives only.
promise: Give an email and get what was promised, or be told exactly what to fix.
expectation: A promise, an email field and one button.
evidence: It ends in a subscription said in place, naming the address, or in an error under the field that says what to do; nothing is left to the page.
behaviour: Busy at once; a bad address or a failure keeps what was typed.
context: A newsletter, release notes, a waitlist.
relationships: Built from a field, a shaped input, a button and an alert.
accessibility: The result is announced; focus returns to the field on an error.
failures: Never ends without saying what happened.
do: Say what arrives and how often.
dont: A subscribe form that only says "Thanks!"

usage.markup: <primal-subscribe title="Get the newsletter" promise="One email per release." [subscribe]="subscribe" />
